content.body:
Icons are displayed above friendly ground units, and as range circles around all aircraft. Hitting tab will toggle through a few different settings, and the num lock display will tell you what setting you are currently using. "Normal" setting shows friendly names, and enemy aircraft "types." "Types" setting shows only unit types for all icons. And finally "no icons" turns off the icon system all together for your display. Note: Even if you have your icons set to "No Icons," other players can still see your icon.
Enemy ground and sea units like troops, tanks, trucks, guns, and ships DO NOT display icons at all. You must aquire and identify enemy ground and sea targets visually. All icons have a "fade in" feature that gradually increases the brightness of the icon the longer you have that unit in view. This system requires you to keep your eyes peeled in combat and adds a bit to the fog of war.
For aircraft, the icons a couple of extra elements, a dynamic range circle, and a dynamic color indicator. The range circle is scaled to 4km at it's full display 1km at half wound, and a quarter circle is 250m. At distances where a reasonably trained pilot would recognize an airplane, you will see a type or name element added along with a color indicator. This tells you if the aircraft is friendly (blue) or enemy (red) and either what type it is or who is flying it (friendly only). With aircraft the fade in system is even more critical, and managing who you are "looking at" and keeping them in view can often be the difference between life and death.
content.title: Icons Manual
